english.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for deliberate hand or body contact, including brief, threatening, or sexual touching.

exampleSentences.jyutping: m4 hou2 lyun6 mo2 ngo5 di1 je5

english.note: Use this for physically touching something or feeling around for an object by touch.

exampleSentences.english: I can feel that the table is still wet.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 mo2 dou2 zoeng1 toi2 zung6 hai6 sap1 ge3

english.note: Use this when handle means touch or feel something with the hand rather than wield it.

exampleSentences.english: Be careful, don’t handle the wound.
exampleSentences.jyutping: siu2 sam1 di1 m4 hou2 mo2 go3 soeng1 hau2
